notes: Jackson is west of Ann Arbor and south of Lansing, so it may be a drive. Teens must commit to all assigned shifts.
name: Summer Youth Program (volunteer)
what_you_do: Volunteer at the hospital for one 4-hour shift a week for 8 weeks in the summer. You get a certificate and a letter that confirms your hours.
who_can_apply: Current high school students who have finished at least freshman year. The page recommends age 16 or older.
duration: 8 weeks, at least one 4-hour shift a week (2026: June 8 to Aug 7)
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. No 2027 dates posted.
how_to_apply: Apply on the hospital page when it opens. Spaces are limited and picks are made after an interview. Orientation is required. The application includes a health screening checklist, and a parent must be there for any shots.
